text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work.
...If you'll excuse me, I'm heading out.

text_block_list.name: Passing Student A
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, wanna play beach volleyball after this?
Let's invite the others too!

text_block_list.name: Passing Student B
text_block_list.text:
The summer festival is tomorrow, right?
My Trainer told me I should go check it out. Wanna come along?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During summer training camp, everyone usually makes time outside of training
to enjoy seaside activities, local festivals, fireworks, and more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Refreshing oneself like that often helps bring
even greater focus to training. However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Believe paid no heed to any of those pastimes,
completely absorbed in a task of her own.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Today... I should be able to make two. Time-wise, quick-drying mortar
should be enough for a quick prototype. One with a base, and a rectangular prism...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A while ago, when we visited her grandparents' home,
her grandfather taught her how to craft mortar single-flower vases—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed she was completely hooked on it.
Lately, she had been relentlessly making prototype after prototype.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Rounded shapes are pretty difficult...
Still, the cubes are coming along nicely, so maybe next...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(As for vase designs... egg-shaped, teardrop, ring-shaped...
—Whoa... this one uses layered plates to represent flower petals.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(......There are actually quite a few plasterwork artists out there.
I need to look at more references and expand my range...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I don't offer to help. Nor do I call out to her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I simply watch over her quietly... wanting her to focus on
her "craft" to her heart's content. To make that possible—

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
The woods in the back? Ah, now that you mention it,
I do see your trainee over there quite often.
choice_data_list: She's working on something very important to her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The place Believe worked in was an unused area for training—
a deserted corner of the woods where students rarely visited.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I go around asking all academy staff and Trainers
to please allow her to use that spot during her free time.

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Of course, that's fine. She looks very focused,
so I'll make sure everyone knows not to disturb her.

text_block_list.name: Rec Committee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Believe's Trainer! We're prepping for the rec activities
right now, but we're short on hands. Is she available?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She isn't in training right now, nor does she have committee duties,
so technically Believe could help out, but...

text_block_list.name: Rec Committee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh, really? You sure?
Thank you so much~!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
......Alright.
Let's try... an egg shape.
choice_data_list: (Looks like she's running low on mortar.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From days of continuous prototyping, the materials she brought were dwindling.
If she had to worry about running out, it might break her concentration.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
What should I do about the opening width...?
Since it's short, I should make it as narrow as possible...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Day after day, Believe spent virtually all of her free time
crafting single-flower vases. As I continued to watch over her—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ——Done.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(The shape is... well-proportioned. The mortar set cleanly too.
And the pattern... is the best one yet.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —Right, the flower...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
This will do for now...
The stem length... about this much, maybe.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ——Yeah. It looks nice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A beautiful, teardrop-shaped single-flower vase. With a clover placed inside,
its simple yet refined, flowing pattern stands out even more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I intended to just watch in silence, but I blurted it out without thinking.
I considered walking away immediately... but I really want a closer look at her creation.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ......It's fine. You can take a look if you want.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Holding it in my hands to admire it... I'm thoroughly captivated once again.
Even to an amateur's eyes, it's clear this is leagues ahead of her previous prototypes.
choice_data_list: This pattern is so delicate and beautiful—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...It's just an ordinary water ripple motif.
choice_data_list: Still, your delicate touch here is amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meticulous, flawless, and beautiful. Precisely because it's a simple pattern,
her sophisticated brushwork truly shines through. Her grandfather's work was the pinnacle of precision, but—
choice_data_list: Your brushwork looks just like your grandfather's!
Your brushwork looks just like your grandfather's!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: No, his lines are much more... delicate and smooth.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the water ripples I drew this time are just a simplified version.
I can't draw patterns as intricate as his yet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even as she states this calmly, the look on her face as she gazes at the vase
seems genuinely satisfied with how it turned out, carrying a hint of quiet pride...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ......Once I make one more, I'll show Grandfather—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —She must feel confident enough now to present her work to her grandfather.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being able to witness this proud gaze and beautiful "work" right by her side
feels like an irreplaceable, truly treasured privilege.
choice_data_list: It's truly beautiful... You're amazing, Believe.
It's truly beautiful... You're amazing, Believe.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ......If you like it that much, you can have it.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind. I plan on making a few more anyway.
Besides...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
There was... extra mortar.
That was you, right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've been found out... Guess I'm still too clumsy
to really pull off 'supporting from the shadows'...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No.
The amount I brought wasn't enough.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: .........It was a big help.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Um... so, that's my thank you.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Don't mention it—
.........I'll hone my skills even more next time.
